title: Grimlings – Minesweeper for 2026
excerpt: The numbers are fangs, the mines are cute monsters, and every board is solvable by pure logic. Descend, collect the bestiary, keep the streak.
content_html:
Grimlings

Minesweeper for 2026

A minesweeper dungeon crawl. The hidden tiles are cute little monsters, and every number is the summed fangs of its neighbours. Deduce where they lurk, descend floor by floor, and never guess — every board is certified solvable by logic alone.

Numbers with teeth

A clue is the summed fangs of the monsters around it — and grimlings come in ranks 1 to 3. A "3" might be one sleepy Maw or three little Nibs. Richer deduction that collapses back to classic minesweeper when everything's a 1.

Hearts, not game over

Dig up a grimling and it bites — you lose hearts, not the run. And because every board is no-guess certified, a perfect line of logic never bleeds a single heart.

Daily Delve & streaks

One shared seed per day, a bounded five-floor gauntlet everyone plays alike. Complete it, bank the streak, earn freezes for the days life gets in the way.

A bestiary to fill

Around thirty collectible species, from common Nibs to legendaries that take weeks of play to meet. Every grimling you encounter is logged, tallied, and yours.

No guessing, ever

A solver walks every floor before you do, so there's always a move you can prove. Stuck means you haven't found it yet — never that the board rolled against you. Why that matters.

Deeper floors, stranger shapes

Descend and the dungeon grows denser: three-fang Maws from depth 3, and boards that bend into diamonds, crosses and octagons. Depth is the score worth screenshotting.

content_html_zh:
格林林斯

2026年扫雷舰

扫雷地牢爬行。 隐藏的图块是可爱的小怪物，每个数字都是其邻居的尖牙的总和。 推断出它们潜伏的位置，逐层下降，永远不要猜测——每块棋盘都经过认证，仅凭逻辑即可解决。

带牙齿的数字

一条线索是周围怪物的尖牙总和——鬼怪分为 1 到 3 级。 “3”可能是一个昏昏欲睡的胃或三个小笔尖。 更丰富的推论，当一切都是 1 时，又会回到经典的扫雷游戏。

红心，游戏还没结束

挖出一只鬼怪，它会咬你——你会失去信心，而不是逃跑。 而且因为每块板都经过了无猜测认证，完美的逻辑线永远不会让任何人流血。

每日探索与条纹

每天共享一颗种子，五层楼的有界挑战，每个人都玩得一样。 完成它，积累连胜，在生活遇到阻碍的日子里获得冻结。

需要填充的寓言故事

大约有三十种可收藏的物种，从普通的 Nibs 到需要数周时间才能遇见的传奇品种。 你遇到的每一次恐怖都会被记录、统计，并且属于你。

从来没有猜测

解算器会先于您走遍每一层，因此总有一个动作可以证明。 卡住意味着你还没有找到它——绝不是董事会对你不利。 为什么这很重要。

更深的地板，更奇怪的形状

下降，地牢会变得更加密集：来自深度 3 的三牙巨口，以及弯曲成菱形、十字形和八边形的木板。 深度是值得截图的分数。
